name: dqn-flappy-bird-site
description: Public website for the DQN Flappy Bird reinforcement learning experiment. Generated with Eleventy.

scripts.build:full: cd .. && bun run build-all && cd site && bun run build && cd .. && for dir in experiments/*/; do slug=$(basename "$dir"); if [ -d "$dir/dist" ]; then mkdir -p "site/_site/game/$slug" && cp -r "$dir/dist"/. "site/_site/game/$slug/"; fi; done
